description: This file defines a custom exception class `ShelfNameExistsException` used within the `com.karankumar.bookproject.shelf` package to signal that a shelf name already exists when attempting to create or rename shelves in the book project.

classes.name: ShelfNameExistsException
classes.description: A custom exception extending `IllegalArgumentException` to indicate that a shelf name already exists within the application.

methods.name: ShelfNameExistsException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the specified shelf name is already used.
